approvals.intro: Choose when the assistant asks you before it spends credits. Your balance always stops a job it cannot pay for, whatever you set here.
approvals.loadFailed: Approval settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
approvals.conflict: These settings changed elsewhere. The latest values are shown; try again.
approvals.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
approvals.aboveCeiling: That is above your workspace's limit. “Don't ask below” can be at most {credits} credits.
approvals.invalidAmount: Enter a number of credits, with at most four decimals.

consent.label: Full access
consent.none: Not confirmed yet. You are asked once when you first switch a chat to Full access.
consent.revoked: You withdrew your confirmation. You are asked again the next time.
consent.outdated_revision: The warning text changed. You are asked to confirm again next time.
consent.blocked_by_workspace: Confirmed, but your workspace admin has not allowed Full access for members.
consent.help: Withdrawing your confirmation switches Full access chats back to Auto at their next step.
consent.revokeDescription: Running Full access jobs continue in Auto mode from their next step. You are asked to confirm again before you use Full access next time.

limit.label: Full access limit
limit.switch: Ask when a job costs more than
limit.helpOn: In Full access I ask you once when a job would cost more than {credits} credits. The default is 1,000 credits.
limit.helpOff: Off: in Full access I never ask about cost. Only your balance can stop a job.
limit.skipHint: You can skip this question for one job by writing “don't ask for approval” in your message.

members.label: Members
members.help: Off by default. Owners and admins can always use Full access; members can only when this is on.

autoFloor.label: Auto: don't ask below
autoFloor.amount: Don't ask below this many credits
autoFloor.help: In Auto mode a job whose total cost stays below this number never asks (now {credits} credits). Your balance still stops any job it cannot pay for.
autoFloor.helpUnknown: In Auto mode a job whose total cost stays below this number never asks. Your balance still stops any job it cannot pay for.
autoFloor.max: Your workspace allows at most {credits} credits here.

jobCap.label: Cap per job
jobCap.help: Optional. A job estimated above this never starts. Empty means no cap.
jobCap.tenant: Your workspace also has a cap of {credits} credits; the lower one applies.
